name: company-research-langgraph
written: 2026-10-08, by reading backend/graph.py, langgraph_entry.py and application.py at the pinned commit, before the detector was run on this project (a held-out check: the detector was not developed on it). A LangGraph StateGraph of ten nodes: grounding fans out to four researchers, which the collector gathers, then curator, enricher, briefing and editor in a line. The researcher edges are added in a loop over a literal list. No conditional edges, so no router.

pipelines.title: The UI's build script: tsc, then vite build

amended: 2026-10-08, after the first measurement: the ui/package.json build chain added. The truth's author had read only the Python graph; eaos.json counts build chains as tooling pipelines, and the same rule applies here. The detector was not changed for it. The first measurement (stages, edges: recall 0.0, precision 0.0) is kept in the worker report: the detector then read neither a graph held on an attribute (self.workflow) nor edges added in a loop over a literal list, both fixed in general, not for this project's names.
